privacy.p1: Lens Click values the privacy of its clients and visitors. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, protect, and share your personal information when using our site and services.
privacy.sec1.li1: Information provided by the user: Account, personal and professional profile, contact, newsletter, and project request data.
privacy.sec1.li2: Essential technical information: Session cookies and temporary connection data used for security and abuse prevention.
privacy.sec1.title: 1. Information Collected
privacy.sec2.li1: Respond to questions, requests, and quotes.
privacy.sec2.li2: Improve our services and user experience.
privacy.sec2.li3: Send communications, news, and promotions (with consent).
privacy.sec2.title: 2. Use of Information
privacy.sec3.p: We use cloud infrastructure providers, currently Cloudflare (Workers, D1 and R2), strictly to operate and protect the service. Professional profiles become public only when the photographer enables publishing; email and phone each require individual permission. Other disclosures occur only when necessary to provide contracted services or when required by law.
privacy.sec3.title: 3. Data Sharing
privacy.sec4.p: Passwords are stored using a cryptographic hash, and authenticated sessions use an essential, HTTP-only cookie. No system can guarantee absolute security.
privacy.sec4.title: 4. Security
privacy.sec5.p: We use only an essential cookie to maintain the authenticated session. The language preference is saved on the device and no analytics cookies are used by LensClick.
privacy.sec5.title: 5. Cookies
privacy.sec6.li1: Access, correction, or deletion of your personal data.
privacy.sec6.title: 6. User Rights
privacy.sec7.p: When an account is deleted through the authenticated area, we immediately remove from LensClick-controlled systems the account data, sessions, recovery tokens and profile photo. Contact messages and newsletter subscriptions are records independent of the account; their deletion or revocation can be requested through the privacy channel, with identity confirmation when necessary. Temporary security counters use irreversible identifiers and expire automatically. Only the minimum necessary may be retained when an applicable legal basis requires it, such as a legal or regulatory obligation. Technical records kept by the infrastructure provider follow its own operational retention periods and legal obligations.
privacy.sec7.title: 7. Retention and Deletion
privacy.sec8.p: This policy may be updated periodically. We recommend that you review this page regularly.
privacy.sec8.title: 8. Policy Changes
privacy.sec9.p: For privacy questions, contact us at lensclick.fotografias@gmail.com.
privacy.sec9.title: 9. Contact
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
